add.label: Link to a GitHub project
add.placeholder: Paste a GitHub link, like github.com/owner/project

empty.title: Run projects from GitHub — no setup needed
empty.body: Paste a link to a project on GitHub above. Repo Launcher downloads it, sets up everything it needs, and starts it for you.

step.createEnvironment: Creating a private space for this project

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This deletes the project and everything Repo Launcher installed for it. Anything the project saved inside its own folder is deleted too.

INVALID_LINK.title: That doesn't look like a GitHub link.

NOT_GITHUB.title: Repo Launcher works with projects on GitHub.
NOT_GITHUB.body: Paste a link that starts with github.com.

REPO_NOT_FOUND_OR_PRIVATE.title: We couldn't find {{repo}}.
REPO_NOT_FOUND_OR_PRIVATE.body: The link may be mistyped, or the project may be private. If it's yours, connect your GitHub account to open it.

RATE_LIMITED.title: GitHub asked us to slow down.
RATE_LIMITED.body: Please try again in about {{minutes}} minutes.

OFFLINE.title: You seem to be offline.
OFFLINE.body: Check your internet connection, then try again.

DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: The download didn't finish.
DOWNLOAD_FAILED.body: This is usually temporary. Try again in a moment.

DOWNLOAD_CORRUPT.title: A download was damaged on the way.
DOWNLOAD_CORRUPT.body: We threw it away to keep your computer safe. Try again.

UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT.title: Repo Launcher can't run this kind of project yet.
UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT.body: It looks like a {{ecosystem}} project. Support for more kinds of projects is on the way.

NO_ENTRY_POINT.title: We couldn't tell how to start this project.
NO_ENTRY_POINT.body: It may be a library or a collection of files rather than an app you can open.

MANIFEST_INVALID.title: This project's setup file has a mistake.
MANIFEST_INVALID.body: Its launcher.json couldn't be used. Copy the diagnostics and share them with the project's author.

MISSING_SYSTEM_TOOL.title: This project needs “{{tool}}”, which isn't on this computer.
MISSING_SYSTEM_TOOL.body: Install {{tool}} using its official installer, then try again.

INSTALL_STEP_FAILED.title: Setup didn't finish.
INSTALL_STEP_FAILED.body: One of the setup steps stopped with an error. Trying again often helps. If it doesn't, copy the diagnostics and share them with the project's author.

NEEDS_COMPILER.title: This project needs extra developer tools.
NEEDS_COMPILER.body: It builds part of itself on your computer, which needs free tools from your system's maker. Install them, then try again.

NOT_INSTALLED.title: This project isn't installed yet.
NOT_INSTALLED.body: Install it first, then launch it.

ALREADY_RUNNING.title: It's already running.
ALREADY_RUNNING.body: Use Open to see it, or Stop to close it.

LAUNCH_FAILED.title: The project couldn't start.
LAUNCH_FAILED.body: Installing it again usually fixes this.

EXITED_EARLY.title: The project stopped right after starting.
EXITED_EARLY.body: Check its activity to see what it said before stopping.
EXITED_EARLY.bodyModule: It's missing a part called “{{module}}”. Installing it again usually fixes this.

START_TIMEOUT.title: The project is taking a long time to start.
START_TIMEOUT.body: It may still be getting ready. Stop it and try again if nothing happens.

CANCELLED.title: Installation cancelled.
CANCELLED.body: You can install it again whenever you like.

PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.title: That project isn't in your library anymore.

INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong on our side.
INTERNAL.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the diagnostics and report it.

KEYCHAIN_UNAVAILABLE.title: Repo Launcher can't save keys on this computer.
KEYCHAIN_UNAVAILABLE.body: It keeps keys only in your system's secure keychain, and none is available. On Linux, install and unlock a keyring such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then try again. Projects that don't need keys still work.

SECRET_TOO_LARGE.title: That value is too long to save safely.
SECRET_TOO_LARGE.body: Keys can be at most {{limit}} characters. Check that you pasted only the key itself.

GITHUB_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Connecting to GitHub isn't set up in this copy of Repo Launcher.
GITHUB_NOT_CONFIGURED.body: Public projects work without it. To open private projects, use an official release of Repo Launcher.

SIGN_IN_EXPIRED.title: The sign-in code expired.
SIGN_IN_EXPIRED.body: Codes last about 15 minutes. Start again to get a new one.

SIGN_IN_DENIED.title: GitHub sign-in was cancelled.
SIGN_IN_DENIED.body: Nothing was connected. You can try again whenever you like.

SIGNED_OUT.title: Your GitHub connection has expired.
SIGNED_OUT.body: Connect GitHub again to keep using private projects.

REPO_NOT_SHARED.title: We couldn't open {{repo}}.
REPO_NOT_SHARED.body: If it's a private project, Repo Launcher may not be allowed to see it yet. Choose it on GitHub, then try again.

MISSING_KEYS.title: This project needs a few details first.

CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please review this project before it's installed.
CONSENT_REQUIRED.body: What it installs or runs has changed since you last agreed to it.

AI_NOT_ENABLED.title: AI suggestions are turned off.
AI_NOT_ENABLED.body: You can turn them on in Settings.

AI_KEY_MISSING.title: Add your Anthropic key to use AI suggestions.
AI_KEY_MISSING.body: AI suggestions use your own Anthropic account. Add a key in Settings.

AI_FAILED.title: The AI suggestion didn't work.
AI_FAILED.body: The AI service didn't answer as expected. Check your key and connection, then try again.

AI_INVALID_RECIPE.title: The AI suggestion couldn't be used.
AI_INVALID_RECIPE.body: Its plan didn't pass Repo Launcher's safety checks, so nothing was run.

signIn.title: Connect GitHub
signIn.instructions: Copy this code, then paste it on the GitHub page that opens.
signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to approve on GitHub…
signIn.permissions: Repo Launcher asks only to read the projects you choose. It can't change anything on GitHub.
signIn.connected: You're connected as @{{login}}. You can now open your private projects.

github.heading: GitHub
github.chooseRepos: Choose which projects Repo Launcher can see
github.why: Connect only if you want to open private projects. Public projects never need it.
github.revoke: Also remove Repo Launcher's access on GitHub

trusted.heading: Trusted publishers
trusted.why: Projects from these GitHub accounts skip the yellow warnings. Serious warnings are always shown.

ai.heading: AI suggestions
ai.toggle: Let AI suggest how to start projects Repo Launcher doesn't recognize
ai.why: Off by default. Uses your own Anthropic account. You'll see exactly what is sent before anything leaves your computer, and every suggestion is reviewed like any other project.

safety.title: Before you install {{name}}
safety.intro: Installing runs this project's code on your computer, with the same access you have. Here's what will happen.
safety.honest: These checks look for common warning signs. They can't prove a project is safe, so only install projects from people you trust.
safety.trustOwnerHint: Future projects from this account skip the yellow warnings.

summary.download: Download the project's files from GitHub.
summary.downloadPrivate: Download the project's files from GitHub using your connected account.
summary.setUpPython: Set up Python {{version}} just for this project.
summary.setUpNode: Set up Node.js {{version}} and {{packageManager}} just for this project.
summary.setUpGo: Set up the Go toolchain just for this project.
summary.installHelpers: Install the add-ons it lists in {{from}}.
summary.openInBrowser: Start it on your computer and open it in your web browser.
summary.runInConsole: Run it in a window inside Repo Launcher.
summary.openWindow: Start it as a desktop app.
summary.useDocker: Use Docker, which you already have, to build and run it.
summary.needsProgram: Use {{name}}, which must already be on your computer.
summary.runSetupCommands_one: Run 1 setup step from the project.
summary.runSetupCommands_other: Run {{count}} setup steps from the project.

PIPE_TO_SHELL.title: Downloads and runs a script from the internet
PIPE_TO_SHELL.body: {{file}} fetches code from the web and runs it straight away, so what runs can change at any time.

ELEVATION.title: Asks for administrator rights
ELEVATION.body: {{file}} uses a command that asks for full control of your computer. Repo Launcher never needs that.

OBFUSCATED.title: Contains hidden code
OBFUSCATED.body: {{file}} runs code that is deliberately scrambled so people can't read it. This is common in malware.

COMMITTED_EXECUTABLE.title: Runs a ready-made program file
COMMITTED_EXECUTABLE.body: {{file}} is a program included in the project rather than built from its readable code, so it can't be checked.

AI_SUGGESTED.title: This plan was suggested by AI
AI_SUGGESTED.body: The project's author didn't write these steps. Read them before agreeing.

NEW_OWNER.title: Brand-new GitHub account
NEW_OWNER.body: The account that published it is {{days}} days old.

ARCHIVED.title: No longer maintained
ARCHIVED.body: Its author has archived it, so problems won't be fixed.

NO_LICENSE.title: No license
NO_LICENSE.body: The author hasn't said how the project may be used.

INSTALL_SCRIPTS.title: Runs its own setup scripts
INSTALL_SCRIPTS.body: {{file}} runs extra commands while it's being installed.

keys.title: Keys and settings for {{name}}
keys.intro: Keys are stored in your computer's secure keychain and given only to this project while it runs.
keys.none: This project doesn't ask for any keys or settings.
keys.storage: Repo Launcher never writes keys to files or logs.

yours.heading: Projects you've shared with Repo Launcher
yours.empty: No projects shared yet. Choose some on GitHub, then come back.
